question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT pr.packaging_id as root_id, 
           pr.contains_id as child_id, 
           pr.qty as accumulated_qty,
           pr.contains_id as current_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (531, 532, 533, 534)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT h.root_id, 
           pr.contains_id as child_id, 
           h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty as accumulated_qty,
           pr.contains_id as current_id
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(accumulated_qty) as total_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    WHERE child_id IN (501, 502)
    GROUP BY root_id
)
